title: Force Push Confirm
description: Stops a force push from silently deleting work on the remote by listing every commit it would drop with author, message and age, marking other people's commits (co-authors and GitHub noreply addresses included) and protected branches, building a --force-with-lease command pinned to the tip you were shown (or --force-if-includes, so an IDE's background fetch can't defeat the lease), and asking you to type the branch name only when someone else's work would be lost.
stops: Teammates' commits erased by force push
